name: arcue
description: Apply Arcue's 3D model reviews and open models in Arcue at a clip and frame.

interface.longDescription: Pin or paint comments on a 3D model or animation in Arcue, and your agent gets the vertices, bones, frame, camera and screenshots behind each one. The plugin teaches Claude Code and Codex to read these reviews, fix the FBX or Blender files, and show models in Arcue: in the app's built-in browser, or in the Arcue desktop app.
defaultPrompt: Apply the Arcue review I pasted
Show me this model in Arcue
